tasks.title: Respond to tracked .env exposure
actions: Revoke and rotate any credentials that may have been committed in .env
Remove .env from Git without printing its contents
Ignore .env and .env.* while allowing a sanitized .env.example
Scan current files and history; coordinate any history purge because Lovable sync is configured
Enable secret scanning or push protection and add a CI secret scan
acceptanceCriteria: No possibly exposed credentials remain usable
.env is not tracked and is ignored
A sanitized environment example documents variable names without secret values
Secret scanning passes on the clean tree
risks: History rewrite can disrupt consumers and Lovable synchronization; credential rotation remains mandatory regardless

tasks.title: Integrate the existing RequestAssistant into Workbench
actions: Import and render RequestAssistant inside or immediately above .workbench-request
Connect language, input, archetype override and input-update props to Workbench state
On adoption, retain the accepted AssistantDraft specification and derive or pass through its analysis explicitly
Clear stale optimizer output and navigate to Compiled Prompts after adoption
Do not call the current run() callback from onAdopt because it rebuilds defaultSpec and overwrites the reviewed draft
Add component tests for template, dialogue, review/edit, adoption, close and restart
acceptanceCriteria: Adopted constraints, advanced controls, output format and specification remain intact
No second generation silently replaces the adopted specification
The original task text survives closing or restarting the assistant

tasks.title: Pass adopted input values into the Playground
actions: Add explicit initialValues support to Playground
Map AssistantDraft.inputValues to prompt placeholders
Reset or reconcile values when prompt identity or placeholder set changes
Keep file extraction client-side and explain that extracted content is sent to a model only when a model run is explicitly initiated
acceptanceCriteria: Matching {{variable}} fields are prefilled on first Playground open
Changing prompt cannot leave stale values silently attached to different variables
Tests verify local file parsing is distinct from model transmission

tasks.title: Localize diagnostics with stable message codes
actions: Give linter findings and readiness blockers stable diagnostic IDs
Add typed English and Arabic translations for titles, details, remediations and announcements
Provide a readable fallback for unknown future codes
Keep localized wording separate from engine decision logic
acceptanceCriteria: Every known diagnostic code has English and Arabic text
Language switching preserves IDs, evidence and behavior
RTL and mixed-script diagnostic layouts pass smoke tests

tasks.title: Add bilingual, version-neutral provider guidance
actions: Add concise Arabic and English provider-family cards, capability context, endpoint requirements and key-handling guidance
Keep model IDs editable and avoid stale hard-coded recommendations for specific model versions
Use a maintained, dated model catalog only if there is a reliable update source
acceptanceCriteria: Provider explanations are bilingual and version-neutral unless verified from a maintained catalog
No unsupported guarantee or stale model-performance claim appears

tasks.title: Reproduce and fix NameTooLong in the prompt-engine test loader
actions: Reproduce the reported failure on the CI Node version after clean dependency installation
If confirmed, replace oversized data-URL module imports with temporary transpiled .mjs files and file URLs, or adopt a compatible TS-aware runner
Preserve current assertions until a separately reviewed behavior change updates them
Run npm test, lint and build from a clean install
acceptanceCriteria: Failure is reproduced before the fix and documented
No data-URL length error remains
All safety and regression assertions still execute
CI passes on Node 22

tasks.title: Reconcile cloud registry setup SQL with the canonical table
actions: Keep the code and Drizzle migration canonical table name prompt_registries unless an intentional migration is approved
Update or clearly retire standalone SQL that defines intent_guard_registry and optional workspace tables
Test the documented migration sequence against a clean Supabase project under RLS
Surface background sync errors and provide retry/status; do not silently swallow failures
acceptanceCriteria: One canonical schema/setup path is documented
App read/write operations match the table and policies created by the documented migration
RLS isolation and sync failure recovery have tests

tasks.title: Resolve classifier drift using a bilingual benchmark
actions: Select one authoritative classifier and define audit-only legacy behavior
Add Arabic, English, mixed-language, ambiguous and overlapping-intent benchmark examples
Replace accidental substring collisions with explicit deterministic matching and tie rules
Label static rule classifications inferred rather than measured
acceptanceCriteria: Benchmark reports per-class metrics and confusion matrix
One classification drives all downstream decisions
Uncertainty and user overrides are visible

tasks.title: Harden model-provider requests and custom endpoints
actions: Test and mitigate SSRF through private/alternate IPv6 addresses, redirects and DNS rebinding
Use provider-supported credential headers where possible and redact secrets from errors/logs
Add timeouts, cancellation, response-size caps, schema validation and server-side usage limits
Add provider-specific malformed response, timeout and URL-security tests
acceptanceCriteria: Disallowed destinations cannot be reached through URL parsing or redirect tricks
Secrets are absent from logs, UI exports and persisted browser storage
Provider calls are bounded and failures are actionable

tasks.title: Clarify and optionally productionize Guardrails operations
actions: Separate demo/local telemetry visibly from authenticated production data
Label heuristic drift and phrase-match scores as estimates, not measured enforcement
If production scope is approved, add durable authenticated telemetry, tenant-scoped policies, server-side enforcement and allowlisted webhook delivery
Keep policy UI from claiming enforcement until the server request path applies policy
acceptanceCriteria: Demo, local, and production states are distinguishable
Only server-enforced policies are labeled enforced
Production audit events are durable, tenant-scoped and tested

tasks.title: Design and implement web subscription entitlements
actions: Choose one billing provider after requirements and regional support review
Model subscriptions, provider IDs, entitlement status, renewal/cancellation and provider event idempotency
Verify webhook signatures and enforce entitlements server-side
Do not store card details; add cancellation/refund/retry and webhook replay behavior
acceptanceCriteria: Sandbox payment lifecycle is idempotent and server-authoritative
Client redirects cannot grant paid entitlements
Webhook retries, cancellation and refund transitions are tested

tasks.title: Evaluate and prototype Android packaging
actions: Validate Capacitor compatibility with SSR, file import, auth redirects, clipboard, downloads and provider calls
Confirm current Google Play rules and billing path before choosing native/web billing
Produce a proof-of-concept and test on a real Android device before committing release scope
Store signing material only in an approved secret manager or CI secret store
acceptanceCriteria: A test Android build installs and completes core workflows on device
Billing approach has documented policy review
Signing credentials are not in source control

verification.reason: Dependencies were absent during repository review; the reported tsgo and NameTooLong results were not independently reproduced.
